title: A simple home with room for lightness

captions.energy: Overloading good things with extra preparation
captions.emotions: Feeling lightness in new domestic experience

meaning: Your domestic support preserves lightness when visible care allows simple good things to be used instead of turning new pleasure into endless preparation.
text: You may enjoy making home somewhere good things are available without a long wait. The Sun in the physical position of Muladhara appears through open actions and shared use of simple convenience. The Empress in energy risks overloading this with additional care. The Fool in emotions wants lightness and new experience. A pleasant opportunity grows more complicated as preparations continue: both want to try differently but supposedly must first create so much comfort that little free time remains for the trial itself.

For example, you decide to have dinner on a small balcony at home for the first time. A table and food already exist, but fairy lights, new napkins and special table settings follow. Twilight passes in searching for what is missing. **Lightness is supported by being able to begin with good things already available.** An ordinary dinner can become a new domestic experience without complete redecoration. Both need not prove care’s seriousness through object numbers before simply sitting together.

The difficulty is considering simplicity insufficiently warm and complicating each further beginning. Novelty loses spontaneity, and domestic pleasure requires major work beforehand. Support grows when preparation is proportionate to present need. Care remains visible through a convenient place and ready food; it need not occupy every free minute to prevent lightness seeming like insufficient participation in shared life.
